name: chief-of-staff
description: An operating model for AI work sessions: a Chief of Staff, a Production VP, a Communication VP, one COO per project and cheap workers. Skills only; no data leaves your account.

interface.shortDescription: Run your AI work like a team
interface.longDescription:
Chief of Staff is an operating model for people who run many AI work sessions at once. One Chief of Staff keeps track of every session, says what really waits on you and routes new work. A Production VP holds one build standard and checks that work is verified before it is called done. A Communication VP drafts and routes what you want said. One COO per project turns your direction into goals and delegates to cheap workers.

This plugin holds the role instructions as skills. It has no server and reads no account data. Decisions come to you as short choices with a recommendation first.

The full system for Claude Code, with scripts and a desktop panel, is open source at https://github.com/GutenGroup/chief-of-staff.
capabilities: Plan the day across many work sessions
Route new work to the right project owner
Hold a build and quality standard
defaultPrompt: Act as my Chief of Staff: what needs me today?
Set up a COO for my side project.
Review this plan against the Production VP standard.

positive.prompt: Act as my Chief of Staff. I have three projects: a web app, a newsletter and taxes. What should I look at first today?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives a short brief with one recommended first item and asks any decision as a choice with the recommendation first.

positive.prompt: Set up a COO for my newsletter.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the short interview (what winning looks like this month, who it reports to) and writes a one-page charter.

positive.prompt: My worker says the fix is done. Is it?
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for the live check pinned to the shipped version before calling it done.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Chief of Staff 1.5.4: the role instructions as skills.
